other_conditions: Must be a regular student of 10+2 academic, professional or technical course in Science/Arts/Commerce stream.
Institution must be a Government, Government Aided or Private school affiliated with the Himachal Pradesh Board of School Education.
Scholarship is awarded based on 10+2 merit declared by the Himachal Pradesh Board of School Education, Dharamshala.
Scholarship is for higher education courses, including undergraduate, postgraduate, and professional courses.
benefits_summary: Scholarship amount of ₹15,000 per annum, renewable for up to five years.
